# polaris_table (Resource)

Manage a Polaris table. Deletion unregisters without purging object data. Nonempty parent deletion is refused by Polaris.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "polaris_table" "example" {
  catalog     = "warehouse"
  namespace   = ["sales"]
  name        = "chosen"
  schema_json = jsonencode({ type = "struct", "schema-id" = 0, fields = [{ id = 1, name = "id", required = false, type = "long" }] })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) Containing catalog.
- `name` (String) Stable object name. Import existing names before applying.
- `namespace` (List of String) Namespace path components; dots remain literal.

### Optional

- `location` (String) Creation-only object location. Omit when importing.
- `partition_spec_json` (String) Creation-only Iceberg partition spec.
- `properties` (Map of String) Only these property keys are reconciled; engine-added keys are preserved.
- `schema_json` (String) Creation-only Iceberg schema JSON. Required to create; omit when importing.
- `write_order_json` (String) Creation-only Iceberg sort order.

### Read-Only

- `current_metadata_location` (String) Current engine-owned metadata pointer; never used to reset registration.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `metadata_json` (String, Sensitive) Current object metadata, excluding response credential-vending configuration.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import polaris_table.example '{"catalog":"warehouse","namespace":["sales"],"name":"chosen"}'
```
